svg.title: The light transport as tiles on the matrix engines
svg.text: y = M x: what each element receives from every other
M as stored: rows the receivers (y), columns the sources (x)
1,151 x 1,151 tiles of 32 x 32, cut by the elements' cluster tree
1 a dense near block, receivers 147-151 by sources 147-151
W^T stored as 5 x 5 tiles: 25 tile products a pass

svg.text: 3 a far block, 72 x 72 tiles, rank 94 (padded to 3 tiles)
dense it would be 5,184 tiles; as V and U^T it is 432
A block of two far boxes (their gap at least the larger diagonal) is low rank when its rank at 1e-2 stores fewer numbers.
The apply: one command, every core, tile products on the matrix engines
y's 1,151 receiver tiles dealt in contiguous ranges, one a core (plan/deal.py): 3 to 16 tiles each, each about 4,500 weight tiles to read
core 1: receivers 12-20, 177 entries (82 dense slices, 95 low-rank), 4,525 weight tiles

svg.text: dense slice: K tiles of x by K x n of w; low-rank: V's products into t, then U^T's into the sums
Sponza: one apply 2,609.3 us; Bistro interior (774,298 tiles) 4,288.0 us; 120 cores of one P150A at 1,350 MHz.
The bounces: one apply a pass
the scene's count of passes, or the control bounces
The X280 cores between the applies: y fetched and added, the next x stored; then the field's values, scale and texels.
